Support for lasting change in your relationship with food

Kim K., BCC Alumna, talks about the work of recovery and why it's worth the effort. Watch her share her experience in her own words.

The Bariatric Counseling Center offers group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in a unique, all-inclusive format. One program, not four.

San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BariatricCounseling #VirtualTherapyTexas #BariatricSupport

YT.title: Recovery Is Worth the Effort | Kim K., BCC Alumna
YT.description: Kim K., BCC Alumna, shares her perspective on the work of recovery and why the effort leads to lasting change. The Bariatric Counseling Center provides behavioral therapy, dietary guidance, culinary classes and mindful movement for people struggling with weight loss, binge eating and chronic overeating. One program, not four. San Antonio and virtual across Texas. Learn more at bariatriccounselingcenter.com/testimonials
